metadata.dataset: Port and harbour registry, Corpus Christi area
metadata.geography: Positions are derived from real geometry in 99_reference/geo (USACE National Channel Framework reaches, NOAA ENC land areas and anchorages, USACE Master Docks points). Terminal and operator names are fictional names placed on real dock sites; the Port of Corpus Christi Authority and government agencies are real.
metadata.routing: Deep-draft ships reach their berths along the channel centerlines. Small craft leave a slip with geo.water.route using a land clearance no larger than the slip's water_route_clearance_m.
metadata.joins: berth_id and slip_id are used by vessels.json (home_berth_id, usual_berths) and by supply/vessel_arrivals.csv (terminal_id, berth_id).
